title: Measure AI by results, not number of agents deployed: Oracle senior executive
summary: Business leaders should pick an outcome they can measure, such as reducing the time spent resolving accounting errors or lowering transport costs, said, Natalia Rachelson, Senior Vice President, Applications Development, Oracle.
llm_summary: Oracle’s senior vice president of applications development, Natalia Rachelson, says the value of AI should be judged by concrete results—not by how many bots or agents a company rolls out. Leaders need to pick a measurable outcome—like cutting the time spent fixing accounting errors or reducing transportation costs—and track the impact. Success, she argues, is defined by the bottom‑line improvement the technology delivers.
